name: qark_apply
title: Write files
description: Create, replace, edit, move, or delete files under the workspace root in one atomic change set. Every file is rendered and syntax-checked (Python, Node, PowerShell, Bash, JSON, TOML) before anything is written; a conflict or failed check writes nothing. Re-sending the same request is safe: identical files report unchanged. The receipt lists each file's status, sha256, bytes, and check result. A new file must not exist unless mode is replace or upsert; to change an existing file, pass edits (exact find, regex find_re, a line range, or anchored inserts) or mode replace with expect set to its current sha256 from qark_read. move renames a file atomically: path is the destination and expect pins the source's sha256. Set diff true to get a unified diff of every change in the receipt, and combine it with dry_run to preview before writing. Use templates with each to fan one template out over a list (one call, many scripts). For a template that already exists, prefer expand: an @template block, a header row, and one record per line. job writes a self-contained directory under jobs/<job> with a manifest.json for the executor.

files.description: What should exist afterwards. Each entry has a path and exactly one of text, lines, tmpl, template, json, edits, move, or delete.

path.description: Relative to the workspace root (or to jobs/<job>). May use {{vars}}.

tmpl.description: Inline Handlebars-style template: {{name}}, {{#each xs}}, {{#if x}}, {{x|py}} literal filters for py js json ps sh.

template.description: Name of a template from templates, qark_templates, or the builtins (py/script, py/pytest, js/script, ps1/script, sh/script).

json.description: Any JSON value, written as pretty JSON.

edits.description: Edits to the current file, in order. Each is one of: {find, replace, all?, count?, occurrence?, within?}; {find_re: regex, replace: text with \0-\9 captures, all?, count?, occurrence?, within?}; {lines:[first,last], with}; {insert_before|insert_after: N or "text" or {find|find_re, occurrence?}, with}; {append}, {prepend}; {ex: vim ex command like %s/a/b/g}; {keys: vim normal-mode keys}. within limits an edit to a span: [first,last] lines, a string, or {find|find_re, occurrence?} naming the span's text. occurrence picks the Nth match, -N counts back; ambiguous matches are refused unless occurrence, count, or all is set.

move.description: Source path moved to this path atomically: the destination gets the source's bytes and the source is deleted in the same commit. expect pins the source's sha256; a stale source refuses the whole apply.

with.description: Variables for this entry's template, layered over vars.

each.description: A list (or the name of a list in vars) to fan this entry out over; the item's fields become variables, plus {{@index}}.

mode.description: create (default) refuses an existing file with different content; replace requires it to exist; upsert does either.

expect.description: sha256 the current file must have, from qark_read or a receipt. With move it pins the source.

check.description: false to skip the syntax check, or a checker name: python, node, powershell, bash, json, toml.

templates.description: Inline templates by name: a string, or {text|lines, lang}.

job.description: Write under jobs/<job>/ and add manifest.json with every file's sha256.

dest.description: Base directory for relative paths (default the workspace root, or jobs for a job).

run.description: With job: how the executor should run it, recorded in manifest.json, e.g. {"argv": ["python", "main.py"], "timeout_ms": 30000}.

prune.description: With job: delete files the previous manifest listed that this spec no longer produces.

dry_run.description: Render and check everything, report what would happen, write nothing.

preview.description: With dry_run: include each file's rendered text in the receipt.

diff.description: Include a unified diff of each changed file in the receipt. With dry_run it previews the change.

check.description: true (default), false, or "required" to refuse when a checker is missing.

expand.description: Shorthand tables. Each block is @template, a header row split on |, then one record per line. A blank line ends a block. A path column names the file; otherwise the template's path pattern is used. A pattern with no {{ and no path column writes one file and the template reads {{#each rows}}.

tag.description: Who or what is writing, recorded in .qark/journal.ndjson.

name: qark_read
title: Read files
description: Read files under the workspace root with their sha256, byte count, and line count, so a later qark_apply can edit them with expect. A directory path lists its entries; "." is the root. Use lines [first, last] to read part of a file, and outline true to get a symbol list (functions, classes, types, sections) without the file's text.

content.description: false returns only hashes and sizes.

outline.description: Include the file's symbols: name, kind, line, and end line for functions, classes, records, and sections.

name: qark_search
title: Search files
description: Search the workspace like ripgrep: pattern is literal text, or set regex true for the qark dialect (. [] () | * + ? {} ^ $ \< \> \d \w \s). Matches come back grouped per file with that file's sha256, line and column numbers, and the matched text; context adds surrounding lines. glob narrows files (* stays within a directory, ** crosses; "*.py" matches by basename, "src/*.py" by path). path limits the search to a directory. With no pattern it lists the matching paths instead. Skips .git, .qark, node_modules, and build output unless all is true; skips binary files and files over 4 MiB.

path.description: Directory to search, relative to the workspace root (default the root).

context.description: Lines of context around each match, 0-20.

max.description: Stop after this many matches (default 100); the reply reports truncated when capped.

max_files.description: Stop scanning after this many files (default 20000).

all.description: Include hidden and tool directories such as .qark.

name: qark_templates
title: List templates
description: List the templates qark_apply can name (session, workspace .qark/templates, and builtin), each with its language, description, and the variables it reads. Pass name to get one template's full text.

name: qark_define_template
title: Define a template
description: Keep a named template for later qark_apply calls in this session, so many files can share it. persist true also saves it under .qark/templates for every future session. A name ending in an extension such as loader.py sets the language its |ident filter checks.

path.description: Path pattern for an expand table, such as gen/{{who|snake}}.py. A constant path writes one file; the template then reads {{#each rows}}.
